description: This file defines the 'Preg' class providing static methods for regular expression operations, including matching, replacing, splitting, and grep, with support for offset and group handling, as part of the composer/pcre package.

classes.name: Preg
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for PHP PCRE regex operations with enhanced null and offset handling.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs regex match, supporting null matches with flags.

methods.name: matchStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex match with strict non-null group enforcement.

methods.name: matchWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs regex match with offset capture support.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Performs regex match all, supporting null matches.

methods.name: matchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex match all with strict non-null group enforcement.

methods.name: matchAllWithOffsets
methods.description: Performs regex match all with offset capture support.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with error handling.

methods.name: replaceCallback
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with callback, supporting null matches.

methods.name: replaceCallbackStrictGroups
methods.description: Performs regex replacement with callback and strict non-null group enforcement.

methods.name: replaceCallbackArray
methods.description: Performs multiple regex replacements with callback, supporting null matches.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits string by regex pattern, excluding offset capture.

methods.name: splitWithOffsets
methods.description: Splits string by regex pattern with offset capture.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Filters array elements matching regex pattern.

methods.name: isMatchStrictGroups
methods.description: Boolean variant of match with strict groups.

methods.name: isMatchAllStrictGroups
methods.description: Boolean variant of matchAll with strict groups.
